Financial Performance Report – FY 2025
and FY 2026
Company: Astravion Technologies
Reporting Currency: AED
Document Version: 1.0

All monetary amounts are expressed in AED millions.

4. Financial Performance in Paragraphs
Meridian Technologies reported revenue of INR 15.5 crore and net profit of INR 2.5 crore for FY
2025. Its operating expenses amounted to INR 85 lakh.
Velmora recorded automated infrastructure efficiency gains of EUR 450,000 and sustainable
energy recovery savings of EUR 125,000 during FY 2026.
Quantivex reported revenue of AED 12 million in FY 2025 and AED 18 million in FY 2026.
